name: AAVAA
evidence: Company press release boilerplate: AAVAA was formed in 2019 to pursue attention-detection; incubated at TandemLaunch by founder Naeem Komeilipoor.
conflict: BetaKit says launched 2021, which reads as commercial launch and CEO arrival rather than formation.

name: Cortivision
evidence: Founder interview via Lublin municipal investment agency: officially operating as a company since March 2019, concept formed in a Warsaw accelerator late 2018. Verifier corrected my 2020.
conflict: Tracxn gives 2020. The 2019 statement describes formal registration, so it is closer to incorporation than to a distinct founding moment.

name: Neuright Labs
evidence: Company-authored text says founded in Maine in 2018 as a C-corp, which is an incorporation statement. UMaine coverage confirms Blaszkiewicz and Townsend formed Neuright out of MIRTA but states no year.

name: Onward Medical
evidence: Founded 2014 in Eindhoven by the EPFL team behind the 2012 spinal-stimulation results (Bloch, Deckers, Courtine). Founded AS G-Therapeutics / GTX Medical; ONWARD is a 2020 rebrand.
conflict: The 2015 figure elsewhere appears to track the rebrand rather than the founding. Verifier found no credible source against 2014.

name: Axonics Modulation Technologies
evidence: SEC Form 424B5: incorporated in Delaware March 2012 as American Restorative Medicine Inc, renamed Axonics Modulation Technologies August 2013, commenced operations late 2013

name: Kernel
evidence: Founded 2016 by Bryan Johnson with a $54M investment; corroborated by kernel.com/about

name: INBRAIN Neuroelectronics
evidence: ICREA official spin-off registry: InBrain Neuroelectronics SL born December 2019. Corroborated by ICN2 spin-off page.

name: Forest Neurotech
evidence: Convergent Research lists Forest Neurotech as a Focused Research Organization it incubated, established 2023 and launched October 2023

name: Braingaze
evidence: ICREA official spin-off registry: Braingaze SL born September 2013; ICREA/University of Barcelona spin-off co-founded by Hans Super and Laszlo Bax.

name: Chronolife
evidence: Company press boilerplate: co-founded in November 2015, iBionext majority shareholder since creation.
conflict: One aggregator floats 2014; no primary source supports it.

name: BrainSigns
evidence: Company About page: born as a spin-off of the University of Rome Sapienza in 2010

name: Synergia Medical
evidence: Company About page: backed by investors since its founding in 2015. I had written 2014 from CB Insights.
conflict: Genuinely unresolved. MecaTech, the Walloon competitiveness cluster, says founded 2014 by Pascal Doguet and Attila Borbath; the company own site says 2015.

name: BRAINCONTROL
evidence: BrainControl is a brand of LiquidWeb Srl, founded in Siena in 2010 by Pasquale Fedele; first prototype shown Oct 2010. 2010 is the PARENT company founding, not a separate entity.
conflict: Product versus parent: BrainControl is a brand, not a separately founded company. Both resolve to 2010.

name: Salvia BioElectronics
evidence: Company About page boilerplate: Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Eindhoven. Secondary reporting adds incorporation 3 Mar 2017 by Hubert Martens, Daniel Schobben and Wim Pollet.

name: BrainCapture
evidence: DTU institutional news, verbatim: once the concept was shaped, the company, BrainCapture, was established in 2019. The underlying research idea dates to 2011 at DTU Compute; the company was spun out in 2019.

name: BrainCo
evidence: Company-issued release boilerplate: BrainCo was founded in February of 2015 and incubated from the Harvard Innovation Lab. Wikipedia agrees independently.

name: Actipulse Neuroscience
evidence: SEC Form C-AR: operating entity Actipulse International SA de CV incorporated 17 Apr 2017; Adrien Chatillon listed as CEO and Founder from January 2017. Y Combinator also lists 2017.
conflict: The same filing shows a Delaware holding entity organised 27 Jun 2019 which acquired the Mexican company in a 2021 share swap. That 2019 is restructuring, not founding.

name: Accure Therapeutics
evidence: Barcelona Science Park: Accure started up in 2020 after a EUR 7.6M Series A, formed by the merger of Iproteos and Bionure
conflict: 2020 is a newly created merger vehicle over Iproteos (founded 2011) and Bionure. If the index counts predecessor lineage, 2011 applies.

name: ADMdx
evidence: Federal contractor record: ADM Diagnostics Inc of Northbrook IL, in business since 2010, registered 23 Mar 2010. Every aggregator agrees on 2010; the company own site states no founding year anywhere.
conflict: An Alzheimer Drug Discovery Foundation grant to ADM Diagnostics LLC covers 8/1/09-7/31/10, so the company was active before the claimed 2010 start. A separate account describes a Chicago predecessor from 2001. Neither is resolved.

name: Activas Diagnostics
evidence: Portland Press Herald, verbatim: Activas Diagnostics, established in 2009 and based in the UpStart Center for Entrepreneurship in Orono. UMaine ECE confirms the spin-off and founders but states no year.
conflict: One aggregator gives 2010, uncited.

name: Cortexplore
evidence: tech2b, the Upper Austrian public startup incubator, lists project start 2018; Austrian commercial register shows registration 03.12.2018. The company own About page states no year.
conflict: All sources converge on 2018 but none is a primary founding statement; the register date is incorporation.

name: Aspen Neuroscience
evidence: Company boilerplate, verbatim: the Loring lab team formed Aspen Neuroscience in 2018. The widely cited Dec 2019 event was the public launch with a $6.5M seed, not the founding.

name: Sunrise
evidence: Company-issued release boilerplate: Founded in 2015 by Laurent and Pierre Martinot. Independently verified.

name: ModiusHealth
evidence: Founded by Dr Paul McGeoch and Dr Jason McKeown in 2015; now operates as Neurovalens from Belfast and San Diego
conflict: Verifier found NEUROVALENS LIMITED (NI617853) incorporated 12 Apr 2013 at UK Companies House, and coverage giving 2015. 2013 is incorporation, not founding. Unresolved between 2013 and 2015.

name: Emotion ID
evidence: Slovak Commercial Register, EMOTION ID s.r.o., ICO 47887231, Bratislava: date of formation 06.09.2014. That is INCORPORATION, and identity with the emotion-detection product is inferred from name, city and address rather than the registered activities.
conflict: Registered activities are generic (advertising, consulting, data processing), so the match to the product company is inferred.

name: MicroVention Terumo
evidence: Company press release boilerplate: Founded in 1997, MicroVention develops and markets medical devices; a company history page adds it was founded in 1997 by a handful of Associates in Southern California. Independently verified. The 2006 Terumo acquisition and the Sept 2024 Terumo Neuro rebrand are separate events.

name: Avalon AI
evidence: Aggregator-only. No primary or institutional source states a year, and UK Companies House has no matching entity. Forbes places the founders pitching at Entrepreneur First demo day in March 2016, consistent with an EF cohort starting late 2015.

name: ATENTIVmynd
evidence: Aggregator-only; no primary source states a founding year. The nearest independent anchor is a product launch, not a founding: ADDitude reports the Atentiv System became publicly available in May 2014. The underlying technology originated at Duke-NUS Singapore, and atentiv.com now redirects to metisminds.com, so a later rebrand may have occurred.

name: Go Go Games Studios
evidence: Stanford GSE learning-design masters project page: founded 2012 by Heidi Williamson, Alexis Hiniker and Joy Wong Daniels, who turned their joint masters project into the company

name: iBand+
evidence: Founder Samir Raut presentation, About us: Founded in December 2016. Likely the Arenar B.V. incorporation, since the iBand+ Kickstarter ran under the Arenar name in Sept 2016
conflict: Tracxn gives 2014, aggregator-only and uncited.

name: NeuroVasx
evidence: Company investor page: originally founded and incorporated in Minnesota in 1998 for catheter-based stroke devices; ceased operations 2011 and reincorporated in Delaware 2014 after an asset purchase
conflict: The company own About page says 2005, which its investor timeline shows is when consulting engineer Steve Ferry was engaged. Crunchbase says 1997.

name: Preventicus
evidence: High-Tech Gruenderfonds investment release, company boilerplate: headquartered in Jena and founded in May 2014, founder Dr Thomas Huebner

name: Neuregenix
evidence: Companies House: NEUREGENIX LIMITED incorporated 14 Jan 2005 as GORDONS80 LIMITED, renamed 11 Apr 2005 — a shelf company taken over. Incorporation and rename, not a stated founding. Dissolved 7 Jan 2025.
conflict: Birmingham Research Park tenant page (now offline) is quoted for founded 2007 by Prof Martin Berry and Dr Zubair Ahmed as a University of Birmingham spin-out; Crunchbase repeats 2007.

name: Oscillo Biosciences
evidence: Company Our Story page: founded 2017 by Dr Edward Large and Dr Ji Chul Kim to translate neural-entrainment research into clinical treatment
conflict: inKnowVation SBIR record gives 2016; SBIR.gov lists awards back to 2007 which appear mis-merged from another of Large ventures.

name: Nuralogix
evidence: Company team page: Dr Kang Lee is one of three co-founders and served as Chief Science Officer from the company founding in 2015 until 1 Sept 2021

name: Accure Health
evidence: inKnowVation SBIR record compiled from federal award data: Year Founded 2016, Pagliuca Harvard Life Lab. Company own About page, LabCentral Q&A and The Engine profile state no year, and EDGAR has no Form D — effectively aggregator-only.

name: Sleepmed
evidence: Company history page: SleepMed was formed in December 1999 through the merger of Sleep Disorder Centers of America and DigiTrace Care Services. Formation by merger, so 1999 is when the entity came into existence.
conflict: The same page dates predecessor SDCA to 1994 and DCSI to 1991, so the underlying business is older than the entity.

name: Blueberry
evidence: NeurotechJP interview with CEO John David Chibuk: Blueberry is a pre-seed startup founded in 2019 in Toronto, led by Chibuk and CTO Dr Steve Mann. Canadian registry shows Blueberry X Technologies Inc registered 13 Jan 2019.

name: Singfit
evidence: Company press boilerplate: Musical Health Technologies was founded in 2014 by Rachel Francine and Andy Tubman, a certified music therapist. AARP AgeTech profile agrees.
conflict: Philadelphia Inquirer (2017) quotes CEO Rachel Francine saying she started the company in 2011 with Tubman. The gap may separate the SingFit product from the MHT entity, but no source says so.

name: Brainjo
evidence: Handelsregister Regensburg HRB 18882: first entered as brainjo UG (haftungsbeschraenkt) on 27/28 Oct 2021, converted to GmbH 29 Apr 2022. OTH Regensburg reported the founding team active and winning the FLUEGGE stipend in March 2021.
conflict: The company own 2026 seed-round boilerplate says founded 2022, which is the UG-to-GmbH legal-form change of the same entity, not a founding.

name: Pixyl
evidence: Pixyl boilerplate: a spin-out of the French labs Inria and Inserm, founded in 2015 by Senan Doyle, Prof Florence Forbes and Prof Michel Dojat. French register shows PIXYL SAS immatriculated 10 Mar 2015; Inria own feature agrees.

name: Nectome
evidence: STAT: Nectome, which McIntyre and his former MIT roommate Michael McCanna founded in 2015. The Y Combinator Winter 2018 batch is accelerator admission, not founding.

name: Brainkey
evidence: Y Combinator company directory, company-supplied: Founded 2018, with the Winter 2019 batch listed separately so 2018 is not the batch date
conflict: Longevity.Technology says BrainKey got off the ground in 2019 when YC backed them, while noting it began as a Stanford postdoc project in 2018. The 2019 marker is accelerator backing.

name: Alpha Trace
evidence: Company 2022 welcome book: Dr Dieter Grossegger established alpha trace in 1980 from his European base in Austria. Austrian Firmenbuch FN 97208 d gives incorporation 4 Dec 1980, the same year.

name: BrainUp (脑陆科技)
evidence: Cyzone: BrainUp came into being in 2018; wearable brain-signal device and KANG sleep product. Chinese register mirrors give incorporation 2018-04-19, the same year. The company own domain no longer serves the company.

name: Great Lakes NeuroTechnologies Inc.
evidence: NIH National Institute on Aging showcase, Company Milestones, verbatim: 2010, GLNT founded as a spinoff from Cleveland Medical Devices Inc
conflict: GLNT own release of 23 Mar 2011 announces the formation of the company with the transition expected over the following months, reading as a public announcement of a spinoff formed earlier. Its About pages carry no year, so the conflict cannot be closed from the company site.

name: FK Biotecnologia
evidence: Company Nossa Historia section, archived: founded 1999 in Brazil by PhD MD Fernando Thome Kreutz. The live domain no longer resolves. Press notes commercial operations began 2002, which is first revenue.

name: Neurolink Medical
evidence: SEC Form D filed 2010-10-18 by Neurolink Inc, San Antonio TX: Year of Incorporation 2007. Strictly an incorporation year; no source states a founding. Technology originated at InCube Labs.
conflict: No source states founding as opposed to incorporation. The filing self-classifies the industry as Pharmaceuticals.

name: Woebot
evidence: Company About page: since our 2017 founding by clinical research psychologist Dr Alison Darcy. Wikipedia agrees independently.

name: BIOS
evidence: Company About page: founded in 2015 by Cambridge graduates Emil Hewage and Oliver Armitage. UK Companies House shows BIOS HEALTH LTD incorporated 5 May 2015 as Cambridge Bio-Augmentation Systems Ltd; the later name is a rebrand.

name: Quantib
evidence: RadNet acquisition release, Jan 2022, boilerplate: founded in 2012 and based in Rotterdam
conflict: RadNet own DeepHealth product timeline says Quantib founded in Rotterdam as an Erasmus MC spin-off in 2013. The acquirer contradicts itself and Erasmus MC offers no tiebreak.

name: TuSion
evidence: Gust profile, company-authored: founded December 2016, St Petersburg, platform for cognitive training with portable EEG. CB Insights agrees. tusion.xyz returned no readable content.
conflict: Aggregator-only, though the Gust profile is company-authored. No independent source.

name: Optimal Medical Therapies
evidence: Company archived history timeline opens: 2000 Formation of OMT, followed by product milestones from 2001. The current live page says only more than 25 years ago, with no year.
conflict: Handelsregister shows first registration 8 Jan 2007 as OMT GmbH at Amtsgericht Stuttgart, converted 2009. That is incorporation of the legal entity, not founding.

name: Molecular NeuroImaging
evidence: Company archived History page: MNI was founded in 2000 by Drs Kenneth Marek and John Seibyl. Acquired by inviCRO Feb 2016.
conflict: MNI own earlier (2003) Founders page says the team united in March 2001 to form Molecular NeuroImaging LLC, and notes Marek was at Yale until March 2001.

name: Novela Neuro
evidence: Company archived About page, headed How Novela Neurotech Started: Founded in 2018, San Francisco, describing a decade of epilepsy neurotechnology research at the University of Waterloo
conflict: Medical Tech Outlook says incorporated in 2013 as a spin-off from Canadian universities and SickKids, with R&D started in 2007. novelaneuro.com is dead; the product lives at neureka.ai.
